categories.name: Robot Framework Fundamentals: The Stranded Protocol
categories.description: You are PROTO-7, a test automation robot who just crash-landed on planet Syntax-IV. Your mentor, MENTOR-9, will teach you Robot Framework to repair the ship's diagnostic systems. Master test syntax, variables, control flow, and test organization to escape the planet.

categories.name: Mastering BuiltIn Library
categories.description: Back at the robot academy, you're training to become a BuiltIn specialist. The BuiltIn library is every robot's core toolkit—always available, never imported. Master logging, assertions, variable scoping, collections, and advanced control flow to earn your certification.

categories.name: API Testing with Robot Framework
categories.description: Your first real mission: test the Galactic Communication Network's APIs. Systems across the galaxy rely on these endpoints. Learn HTTP methods, authentication protocols, JSON validation, and advanced patterns to ensure the network stays operational.
